newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: IBCA re-affirms McCarthy Retail ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA re-affirms McCarthy Retail ratings.

text.p: International rating agency IBCA on Monday re-affirmed both the short and long-term ratings of McCarthy Retail Ltd.
IBCA said in a statement the short-term rating remained at "A1" and the long-term rating was also unchanged at "A".
The ratings indicated a low expectation of investment risk.

"These were accorded on the basis of McCarthy's sound business risk profile, established by the merging of McCarthy Group's motor interests together with the retailing operations of Prefcor in 1992, and strong operating performance," IBCA said.
However, the group retained an inherent sensitivity to fluctuations in business confidence, interest rates and trends in consumer spending.
